handouts.title: Electrolyte Replacement on a Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: How to maintain healthy electrolyte levels on a ketogenic diet. Covers sodium, potassium, and magnesium — food sources, supplement options, and how to manage keto flu symptoms.

handouts.title: Your Guide to the Ketogenic Diet
Managing Illness Safely on Your SGLT2 Medication
handouts.description: Sick day rules for patients taking empagliflozin (Jardiance), dapagliflozin (Forxiga), or canagliflozin (Invokana). When to hold your medication, ketone monitoring, and when to seek emergency care.
